diagnostic_validation: 36 monthly issue dates, 15th of each month in 2019-2021
training_configurations: 200-step bounded adaptation test if smoke succeeds
selection: Select the adapter with lower ET0 MAE on diagnostic validation; report Tmax separately. Do not tune after held-out evaluation.
held_out_issue_dates: Every 7 days from 2026-07-01, retaining only origins with all seven target dates no later than 2026-10-31
cutoff: D-7 for every target channel; predict 14 steps and score steps 8-14 as D+1 through D+7
context: 60 complete historical days ending at cutoff
interpretation: Adapter improvement must be assessed against both the unchanged checkpoint and useful simple baselines, separately for Tmax and ET0. A short seasonal test is not deployment validation, irrigation advice, or evidence of better crop outcomes.
limitations: Historical revised archive with simulated latency
No near-term agricultural decision usefulness trial
No station truth validation of ET0 labels
